sections.title: Room page styles
sections.what: Four rules: a badge row that wraps, a padded panel laid out in a stack, a short bulleted story list, and small muted text for notes.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps spacing consistent across the room pages.
sections.watch_out: The rules use variables defined elsewhere, so renaming those variables would change how the room pages look.

summary: Small stylesheet for the Event Rooms pages: badges, panels, the story list, and notes.
purpose: Sets spacing and layout for room pages.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: keeps room pages consistent.
how: Four class rules, with no screen-width rules. Each applies to elements on the room pages.
inputs: The class names on room page elements.
risks: The rules use text colour and text size variables that are defined elsewhere. If those are missing, the text falls back to default styles.
debug: If badges or notes look unstyled, check that the variables exist in the global stylesheet.
